auth_details: Google Cloud API key as query parameter key=YOUR_API_KEY; enable the Perspective Comment Analyzer API in Google Cloud Console
free_tier_limits: 1 QPS free by default; higher free quotas available on request (see docs)
paid_plans: Contact for higher quotas; primarily free with request-based quota increases
rate_limits: Default 1 query per second (QPS); higher limits available via quota request
example_request: curl -X POST 'https://commentanalyzer.googleapis.com/v1alpha1/comments:analyze?key=YOUR_API_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"comment":{"text":"This is a test comment"},"languages":["en"],"requestedAttributes":{"TOXICITY":{}}}'
description: Google's Perspective API scores text for toxicity, severe toxicity, insult, threat, identity attack, and related attributes using machine learning models trained for content moderation. Developers send comment text and receive attribute probability scores for filtering, ranking, or flagging user-generated content.
resolution_notes: pending live verification of auditor disputes
